'''Armored landers''' were anti-personnel war vehicles used by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. In [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]], [[New Republic Marine]]s used armored landers during the [[Battle of Mindor]] against the forces of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="Mindor">''[[Luke Skywalker and the Shadows of Mindor]]''</ref>

==Appearances==
*''[[Luke Skywalker and the Shadows of Mindor]]'' {{1st}}
